beaches.name: Myrtiotissa (Μυρτιώτισσα)
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers mix across the whole beach without formal designation. The Municipality of Central Corfu's visitor site calls it an unofficial nudist beach; naturist reports from 2014 to 2018 describe the southern part as mostly nude with many clothed visitors in high season. Sunbeds and a canteen operate; the word NUDIST is set into the road surface at the top of the steps.

beaches.name: Halikounas (Χαλικούνας)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is practised at the far south-eastern end, past the kitesurf club. Naturist-directory reports from 2012 to 2025 count between none and around twenty nudists between the snack bars and toward the Lake Korission canal, while the north-western stretch is mostly clothed and clothed walkers pass through. No source mentions signage, and the municipal tourism page for the beach does not mention nudism.
